finding: The bibliography is resolved. Meyer constructs a virtual representation whose character is a variant of the Weil distribution. That is not, from the available theorem statement alone, an exact identity with Li’s concrete Hilbert-space operator T_h. Li 2015 is the likely direct source for the explicit trace identity, but its exact theorem text was not available in a fully inspectable primary-source form in this environment.
